question: As per Economic Survey 2020-2021, during the first half of the financial year 2020-21, the services sector contracted by almost ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**16%**__*.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to** Economic Survey 2020-21 **during the first half of the financial year 2020-21,** **the **services sector contracted **by almost **16 percent.**
 
• This decline was led by a sharp contraction in all sub-sectors particularly **Trade, hotels, transport, communication & services related to broadcasting, which contracted by 31.5 percent in H1 FY 2020-21.**
 
• The services sector accounts for over **54% of India’s GVA and nearly four-fifths of the total FDI inflow into India.**
 
• The Indian start-up ecosystem has been progressing well amidst the COVID-19 pandemic, being home to 38 unicorns - adding a record number of 12 start-ups to the unicorn list last year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance presents the Survey in the Parliament every year, just before the Union Budget.
 
• It is prepared **under the guidance of the Chief Economic Adviser of India.**
 
• The Economic survey 2020-21 was dedicated to the **Corona Warriors**.
 
• According to the Economic survey 2020-21, **India’s real GDP recorded an 11.0% growth in FY2021-22 and nominal GDP grew by 15.4% – the highest since independence**.
 
• India expected to have a Current Account Surplus of 2% of GDP in FY21, a historic high after 17 years.
